subject.title: Dashboard: chart widgets (line, bar, area, sparkline, gauge)

question: Should chart widgets be sponsored as first-party builtins in the bundled dashboard stack, or deferred to an external widget SDK/ClawHub package until the dashboard direction lands?
rationale: Current main lacks the dashboard widget surface, and repository vision supports web frontend ergonomics while keeping optional capabilities behind plugin, ownership, and security guardrails that automation cannot choose.

options.title: Sponsor dashboard builtins after the base lands
options.body: Keep this issue open and implement the chart renderers in the dashboard plugin/widget surface once the base dashboard PRs and binding contract are approved.

options.title: Narrow to widget API first
options.body: Use this issue to define only the chart data/rendering contract and leave concrete chart packages to external plugins or ClawHub until maintainers want bundled defaults.

options.title: Defer chart widgets
options.body: Leave the roadmap item parked until operators need charts strongly enough to justify another bundled dashboard surface.

recommendation.title: Sponsor dashboard builtins after the base lands
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and implement the chart renderers in the dashboard plugin/widget surface once the base dashboard PRs and binding contract are approved.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the closest merged Control UI plugin-tab seam and is the strongest current-main routing signal for whether another bundled native tab/widget surface should be sponsored.
